title: Spotify House — SXSW poster
slide_intent: Distribute a short event identifier through the image because deliberate spatial rhythm can make familiar letters feel expressive and memorable.
strategic_value: Spotify can tie its House event to artist culture through a duotone profile and widely separated white letter groups.
demonstration: A green-blue portrait poster spreads S, SW and a rotated X across the field, with two short top captions and a central Spotify symbol.
practical_value: Compare dispersed display letters with compact supporting copy when building an event poster.

content_islands.name: Event letterforms
content_islands.spec: S at upper left, SW across the portrait and X near the bottom create a vertical reading path.

content_islands.name: Portrait and symbol
content_islands.spec: A profile portrait fills the field; a small white Spotify symbol sits near the center.

content_islands.name: Supporting captions
content_islands.spec: Spotify House is Back and New Music, Epic Vibes sit in two compact groups at the upper right.
